kid.note: Raw unscaled KID; negative estimates are valid. std is subset variability, not a confidence interval.

interpretation: Distances: lower is closer. PRDC: higher fidelity/coverage. Vendi measures diversity, not realism. Null/undefined is not a perfect match. No universal quality threshold or aggregate score.
warnings: FID: sample covariance is rank deficient; small-set scores are exploratory
Ensure comparable nm/pixel and annotation rules. Adjacent slices and patches are correlated observations.
